summary.text: Walter Hall is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates for District 58, which he has represented since December 2022, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a licensed insurance agent.

paragraphs.text: Walter Hall was born in South Charleston, West Virginia, and graduated from St. Albans High School.
He earned a B.B.A. in marketing from Marshall University.
His career experience includes working as a licensed insurance agent, and he volunteered as a member of the St. Albans Chamber of Commerce and the St. Albans Rotary Club.
Hall took office in the House of Delegates on December 1, 2022, succeeding Republican George Miller, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
